subject: Pipeline triage: finalize amount, SKU, next step, and probability for open Q3 deals
messages:
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline triage: finalize amount, SKU, next step, and probability for open Q3 deals

Team —

Quick reminder ahead of finance sign-off next Thursday: we need definitive values in CRM for any Q3 commit-opps by EOD Wednesday (08/15). Finance is doing a pre-close pass and missing or ambiguous fields (amount = 0 / product not set / next step blank / probability unset) are being pulled into the "at-risk" bucket.

Please do the following for your open deals:
- Confirm the final ARR/amount (no ranges).
- Pick the primary SKU/product from the catalog (do not use free-text).
- Set the next step (one-line) and the expected close action (e.g., Contract sent, PO pending).
- Update the probability to a percentage that reflects close confidence (use 25/50/75/90 guidelines).

I've attached a one-row audit template (forecast_audit_template.csv) and put a folder in Drive with example entries. If an AE cannot verify a value, move the deal to "Stalled - needing info" and note the blocking item in next step. Finance will not accept "unknown" amounts.

Related: Aurora UX / AW-2028-1145 is still showing a $0 amount and "Custom Integration" as free text — we need a SKU. Ben, you own this one; please confirm before EOD Wed.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sales Ops Manager, Redwood Inference

- Amount: Sophie confirmed $180,000 ARR (subscription + onboarding).
- SKU: This maps to "Platform - Enterprise (with Integration)" SKU code PF-ENT-INT (entered into product picklist).
- Next step: Contract sent for signature (DocuSign link below).

I uploaded updated fields in HubSpot and attached the demo notes and our contract draft (aurora-demo-notes.pdf). DocuSign: https://docusign.com/tx/aurora-1145

Appreciate the updates — finance did a pre-pass this morning. Two quick calls-to-action from their side:
1) For any deal where amount is > $100k and probability < 50%, provide a short note in the deal timeline explaining the blocker and next required step (finance is using these notes for risk scoring).
2) We will move deals with missing SKUs or amount = 0 to "Stalled - needs data" before the Friday close. If you disagree with that classification, escalate to me with concrete evidence.

Ben: thanks for fixing Aurora UX. Marissa: thanks for the cleanups — can you send your 15-min slot options? I'll join to confirm a final list that finance will accept.

Lauren Bishop
